verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents a transactional API for one-to-one sends triggered by user actions such as password resets and purchase receipts, with per-call data like reset URLs (docs-25, docs-52, docs-14). These sends go through the App API, the same API used for broadcasts, alongside automations and broadcast marketing sends on one platform (docs-23, docs-44, docs-13, docs-43). Missing for 10: magic links are not named explicitly (only password-reset URLs), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of transactional email delivery.
